Create a complete single-file artisan bakery website with the following features:

**Design & Visual Style:**
- Warm, rustic color palette: Cream (#FDF8E7), warm brown (#8B4513), golden amber (#DAA520), soft terracotta (#CD853F), sage green (#9CAF88)

- Responsive design that works beautifully on mobile, tablet, and desktop

- Hover effects on product cards (lift, shadow increase)
- Simple cart counter that increments when "Add to Cart" is clicked
- Mobile menu toggle
- Subtle animations on scroll (fade-in effects)

**Libraries:**
- Google Fonts: Playfair Display, Lato
- FontAwesome CDN for icons (optional)

**Technical:**
- All CSS in <style> tags
- All JavaScript in <script> tags at end of body
- Semantic HTML5 structure
- Accessible markup with proper ARIA labels
</description>
